parameters.query: INSERT INTO stories (story_code, title, subtitle, age_band, min_age, max_age, reading_level_system, reading_level, category, themes, emotional_focus, sight_words, vocabulary_tier, estimated_read_time_minutes, page_count, modes_supported, illustration_style, curriculum_alignment, learning_objectives) VALUES ('SS-GEN-' || to_char(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '{{ $json.title }}', '{{ $json.subtitle }}', '{{ $json.age_band }}', CASE WHEN '{{ $json.age_band }}' = 'pre_k' THEN 2 WHEN '{{ $json.age_band }}' = 'k_prep' THEN 4 WHEN '{{ $json.age_band }}' = 'grade_1' THEN 6 WHEN '{{ $json.age_band }}' = 'grade_2' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, CASE WHEN '{{ $json.age_band }}' = 'pre_k' THEN 3 WHEN '{{ $json.age_band }}' = 'k_prep' THEN 5 WHEN '{{ $json.age_band }}' = 'grade_1' THEN 7 WHEN '{{ $json.age_band }}' = 'grade_2' THEN 8 ELSE 10 END, 'guided', 'A', '{{ $json.category }}', ARRAY[{{ $json.themes.map(t => "'" + t + "'").join(',') }}], ARRAY[{{ $json.emotional_focus ? $json.emotional_focus.map(e => "'" + e + "'").join(',') : "'joy'" }}], ARRAY[{{ $json.sight_words.map(w => "'" + w + "'").join(',') }}], 1, {{ Math.ceil($json.page_count * 0.5) }}, {{ $json.page_count }}, ARRAY['read_to_me', 'read_with_me', 'read_alone']::reading_mode[], 'soft_flat', ARRAY[{{ $json.curriculum_alignment.map(c => "'" + c + "'").join(',') }}], ARRAY[{{ $json.learning_objectives.map(l => "'" + l + "'").join(',') }}]) RETURNING *
